title: Ohio Department of Health — Mosquitoes in Ohio
evidence_use: Ohio species presence, habitats, host context, and May–October activity statement
use_limitations: Page-level distribution is not an abundance survey; lack of a record is not absence.

title: Ohio Vector-borne Disease Surveillance Update
method_or_product: trapping, pooled mosquito samples, laboratory surveillance
evidence_use: 2025 Ohio mosquito-pool and human/vector surveillance summaries
use_limitations: Species-specific pool counts, trap effort by county, and local transmission are not established by the summary.

title: Ohio West Nile Virus Disease in Ohio Map
evidence_use: Contextual human-case observation only
use_limitations: County of residence is not county of infection or local transmission; human cases are not vector abundance.

title: Ohio State University Ohioline — Northern House Mosquito
method_or_product: species fact sheet and cited literature
evidence_use: Culex pipiens habitat, host, seasonality, life-cycle and surveillance context
use_limitations: Fact-sheet claims are not a Western Basin abundance estimate; clinical material is not used as a disease model.

title: Invasive Aedes japonicus Mosquitoes in Wooster, Ohio
method_or_product: CDC light, BG-Sentinel, and gravid traps; morphology and molecular confirmation
evidence_use: Regional evidence of Ae. japonicus establishment and trap-specific composition
use_limitations: Wooster trap composition cannot be generalized to the Western Basin or treated as regional abundance.

title: Establishment of Aedes japonicus in Michigan
method_or_product: CDC gravid and New Jersey light traps
evidence_use: Midwest container-habitat and surveillance-method context
use_limitations: Study-area findings do not establish current Western Basin distribution or abundance.

title: Michigan EZID Annual Surveillance Summary
method_or_product: local health department mosquito sampling, identification, and laboratory testing
evidence_use: 2023 mosquito-pool totals, arbovirus detections, and invasive Aedes response context
use_limitations: Participating jurisdictions and methods vary; mosquito-pool positives are not human cases or local transmission.

title: Michigan Emerging Disease Issues — West Nile virus
evidence_use: Michigan surveillance-program context
use_limitations: Program page is not a species abundance or local vector-density dataset.

title: Indiana Department of Health — Aedes albopictus
method_or_product: distribution map and species life-cycle page
evidence_use: Indiana Ae. albopictus presence, container habitat, and temperature-linked development context
use_limitations: Known distribution map is not a continuous range or abundance surface; effort is not reported on the page.

title: Indiana Department of Health — First 2026 WNV Case
evidence_use: 33 counties with positive mosquitoes and one contextual human case

title: CDC — About Mosquitoes
evidence_use: Vector-versus-pathogen distinction and environmental determinants of mosquito life span
use_limitations: General biology is not a Western Basin occurrence or abundance record.

title: CDC — Mosquito Surveillance Traps
evidence_use: Trap selectivity, life-stage coverage, and effort limitations
use_limitations: Different traps sample different species and life stages; trap counts are not interchangeable abundance measures.

title: CDC — Data and Maps for West Nile
geographic_scale: United States / state and territorial reporting
evidence_use: Separate mosquito, animal, and human surveillance streams
use_limitations: Reported case data and vector data are distinct surveillance products.

title: CDC — About West Nile
evidence_use: Bird–mosquito ecological context and seasonal activity framing
use_limitations: Used only as ecological context; no infection probability or clinical model is created.

title: CDC — Where Ticks Live
evidence_use: Ixodes scapularis and Dermacentor variabilis regional relevance, habitat/season context
use_limitations: Approximate distributions are not precise local maps or abundance estimates.

title: CDC — Tick Data
evidence_use: Availability and scope of tick surveillance products
use_limitations: Dashboard availability does not imply uniform sampling or comparable effort.

title: CDC — Tick Surveillance Data Sets
evidence_use: Established/reported/no-record status definitions and non-absence caveat
use_limitations: County status is cumulative and sampling/reporting is heterogeneous; no-records is not absence.

title: CDC — Blacklegged Tick Surveillance
geographic_scale: United States / county and modeled suitability context
evidence_use: Ixodes scapularis established-status definition and seasonality
use_limitations: Six-or-more threshold is a status rule, not an abundance index; current workbook used here is the 2023 summary.
retrieval_provenance: Actual workbook bytes retrieved from restoredcdc.org mirror; mirror is not CDC-hosted; direct CDC binary URL returned HTTP 403.

title: CDC — American Dog Tick Surveillance
geographic_scale: United States / county and broad distribution
evidence_use: Dermacentor variabilis broad regional relevance and surveillance caveat
use_limitations: No current core-county D. variabilis workbook was ingested; no local abundance claim is made.

title: CDC — Lyme Disease Surveillance and Data
evidence_use: Context for the distinction between human case records and exposure/transmission location
use_limitations: Human cases are not vector records, local transmission proof, or exposure locations.
